description: Extract clean, structured data from news or blog articles. Returns main text/HTML, author, publish date, images, media, RSS feeds, and more.

auto_proxy.description: Auto-escalate to better proxy on failure. Default: false

custom_proxy.description: Custom proxy URI: scheme://user:pass@host:port (required if proxy_type='custom')

image_analysis.description: Analyze images for minimum dimensions. Default: true

image_timeout.description: Image fetch timeout in seconds. Default: 2

images.description: Extract all images from article. Default: true

is_article.description: Return probability [0-1] of URL being an article (>=0.5 is likely article). Default: true

js.description: Execute JavaScript: 'true', 'false', or 'auto' (let extractor decide). Default: 'false'

js_timeout.description: JS engine timeout when js=true (seconds). Default: timeout/2

media.description: Extract embeddable media (YouTube, Twitter, etc.). Default: false

min_image_height.description: Minimum image height in pixels (requires image_analysis=true). Default: 100

min_image_width.description: Minimum image width in pixels (requires image_analysis=true). Default: 200

pagination.description: Extract and concatenate multi-page articles. Default: true

pagination_max_pages.description: Max pages to extract when pagination enabled. Default: 30

partial.description: Number of characters or percentage (with %) of text/HTML to return. '0' for all. Default: '0'

proxy_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for premium proxy. Default: 'US'

quick_mode.description: Fast analysis mode (30-60% faster, slightly less accurate). Default: false

raw_html.description: HTML content to extract from (skips fetching from url, but url still needed for resolving relative links)

return_only_enclosed_text_images.description: Return only images within extracted article HTML. Default: true

scroll_down.description: Scroll down page when JS enabled. Default: true

session_id.description: Session ID (1-16 alphanumeric chars) to route through same proxy. Active 30 min

strip_tags.description: Comma-separated CSS selectors/tags to remove before extraction (e.g., 'meta,form,.hidden')

url.description: URL of the article to extract

name: ujeebu_extract
